contentHtml:
Struggling to find the right number to call Nafis? You’re not alone. Many UAE nationals and businesses are eager to connect with Nafis but end up chasing outdated numbers or getting stuck in endless loops. This article solves that.

We’ll show you the correct Nafis contact number, city-specific support lines, address info, and smart ways to get fast help in 2025. Whether you’re an Emirati jobseeker or a business managing Emiratisation, everything you need is right here.

What is Nafis, and why does the Nafis Contact Number matter in the UAE

Nafis is a federal program launched under the UAE government’s Emiratisation strategy. It aims to boost the employment of UAE nationals in the private sector by offering salary support, job-matching services, child allowances, and other incentives.

Since its rollout, both individuals and companies have been actively seeking assistance from Nafis. That’s why finding the verified Nafis contact number has become so important in 2025.

Verified Nafis Contact Details for 2025

The official Nafis support line is consistent across the Emirates. Whether you are calling from Abu Dhabi, Dubai, or any other city, this number is your go-to.

UAE-Wide Nafis Contact Number

The main toll-free hotline for all Nafis-related queries:

Location Contact Number Availability Languages
UAE (All Cities) 800-62347 (800-NAFIS) 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM (Mon–Fri) Arabic, English
International +971-800-62347 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM UAE Time Arabic, English

This line is free for callers within the UAE and connects you directly to a Nafis support representative. This is the primary NAFIS contact number that should be saved

Nafis Contact Number Dubai

If you’re based in Dubai and want to speak to someone from Nafis or visit in person, here’s what you need to know.

The same toll-free line (800-NAFIS) also works for Dubai. However, for those seeking face-to-face assistance, Nafis representatives are available at government happiness centers.

Dubai Office Location:

  • Emirates Towers, Sheikh Zayed Road, Dubai

Even though there isn’t a city-specific number, searching for nafis contact number dubai will still lead you to the 800-NAFIS line.

Nafis Contact Number Abu Dhabi

For residents in Abu Dhabi, the process is equally simple. Since many Nafis services are centrally managed from the capital, support tends to be quicker and more direct.

Main Office Address:

  • Khalifa City A, Ministry of Human Resources & Emiratisation, Abu Dhabi

Phone Number:

  • 800-62347

Whether you’re looking to resolve application delays, check payment issues, or register your company, this is the confirmed nafis contact number abu dhabi.

How to Reach Nafis Online

Prefer not to call? Nafis has upgraded its digital services to allow users to resolve most queries online. This is especially useful outside regular working hours.

Official Website: www.nafis.gov.ae
 From this portal, users can access live chat, check application statuses, or submit inquiries using their UAE Pass login.

Social Media Support:

  • Instagram: @nafisuae
  • Twitter/X: @nafis_uae
  • LinkedIn: Nafis UAE

Though not suitable for formal complaints, social channels are great for getting quick updates or sharing general concerns.

Common Reasons People Call Nafis

Understanding why people call Nafis helps you communicate your need clearly when speaking with a representative. Here are the most common scenarios:

Emiratis Following Up on Job Benefits

Many UAE nationals use Nafis to ask about:

  • Job matching services
  • Eligibility for salary support
  • Status updates for benefit applications.

Employers Managing Emiratisation Quotas

Private-sector companies often contact Nafis to:

  • Submit monthly Emirati employment reports
  • Ask about incentive eligibility.
  • Solve registration issues on the Nafis portal.

Parents Applying for Child Allowance

The Nafis child allowance program also leads to frequent queries:

  • Document submission deadlines
  • Follow-up on pending approvals
  • Bank transfer delays

Preparing Before You Call Nafis

Calling a government support line can feel frustrating, unless you’re well-prepared. Here’s how to make the call productive.

Keep These Details Ready:

  • Your Emirates ID number
  • Nafis’ application or reference number
  • Your company’s trade license (if you’re an employer)

This saves time and allows the agent to retrieve your file quickly.

Best Time to Call Nafis

Avoid peak times if you want faster service. The hotline is usually busiest between 9:00 AM and 11:00 AM on Sundays and Mondays.

Best Calling Hours:

  • Mid-mornings on Tuesdays or Wednesdays
  • After lunch (2:00 PM – 4:00 PM) on any weekday

Planning your call wisely helps avoid waiting on hold for too long.

What to Do If You Can’t Reach Nafis

There may be times when the line is busy or closed. Don’t worry, there are backup options.

Email Support

Write to [email protected] with a clear subject line, your full name, and Emirates ID. Attach any supporting documents if needed. You can usually expect a reply within 1–2 business days.

Use the Live Chat Tool

Visit the Nafis website and scroll to the bottom right corner. The live chat function connects you to agents who can guide you through portal issues or general inquiries.

In-Person Visits

Nafis is supported by Customer Happiness Centers in:

  • Dubai: Emirates Towers
  • Abu Dhabi: Khalifa City A
  • Sharjah: Al Qasimiya

Walking in for support is especially helpful for complex matters that need documentation or verification.

Important: Avoid Fake Nafis Numbers

There have been scams involving fake Nafis representatives contacting people. Remember, the only official NAFIS contact number is 800-62347. Never share personal details with unofficial numbers or websites.

Quick Recap Table: Nafis Contacts and Locations

Here’s a quick summary for easy reference:

Area Contact Method Use Case
UAE-wide 800-NAFIS All individual and company support
Dubai Emirates Towers Walk-in service for job seekers & firms
Abu Dhabi Khalifa City A Fast-track support and documentation
Website nafis.gov.ae Live chat, status checks, and email support
Social Media @nafisuae Public updates, quick Q&A

FAQ: What People Often Ask About Nafis

To wrap up the most pressing questions, here are a few answers that may help if you’re still unsure where to turn.

Is 800-NAFIS the same for all Emirates?

Yes, this is the standard Nafis contact number UAE residents can use, no matter the city.

Can expats call Nafis?

No, Nafis’ services are specifically designed for UAE nationals. However, companies that employ Emiratis can call the line for assistance.

Is it okay to speak in Arabic?

Yes, Nafis support agents are bilingual in Arabic and English.
